help.stdout:
usage: gnd evolve [-h] {preview,apply,finalize} ...

Run the staged offline evolution protocol over explicit files. Preview
validates without mutation; apply revalidates the exact reviewed preview,
performs the model CAS, and completes the live conformance recheck in one
invocation; finalize completes a pending state left behind by an interrupted
apply. The CLI does not propose changes, repair projects, or select a runtime.

positional arguments:
  {preview,apply,finalize}
    preview             validate a proposal and publish one immutable review
                        claim
    apply               revalidate an exact preview and complete the whole
                        evolution
    finalize            complete exact pending leaves and publish the final
                        record last

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
